title: ExecutionPage A/B curve test supplied fewer preflights than requested RPM points
symptom: IndexError: list index out of range at execution_page.py:400
root_cause: The test relied on dialog defaults while its prepare_power_curve mock returned only seven point_preflights; the dialog default range produces more RPM points.
resolution: The test now sets curveStartRpm=3000, curveStopRpm=6000 and curveStepRpm=500 explicitly, matching the seven preflights it supplies.
